articleTitle: Visual SLAM System Integrating Feature Extraction Based on Vision Transformer and Cloud-Edge Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Deep learning-based visual SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) has become one of the highly researched areas in recent years. Deep learning can be integrated with various modules of visual SLAM systems, including VO (Visual Odometry), mapping, feature extraction, localization, BA (Bundle Adjustment) optimization, loop closure, dataset handling, etc. In visual SLAM, traditional feature point extraction using deep learning networks is based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures. This paper proposes a method that combines feature extraction based on the vision Transformer network with edge-cloud technology to improve the performance of visual SLAM systems. This method addresses scenarios where neural network-based SLAM systems encounter limited computing resources, frequent environmental changes, or require real-time response. Experimental results demonstrate that the fusion of feature extraction based on vision Transformer and edge-cloud technology significantly improves the localization, mapping, and real-time performance of visual SLAM systems. It exhibits excellent robustness and accuracy in various indoor and outdoor environments, indicating promising application prospects and dissemination value.

articleTitle: Surface Damage Detection Algorithm of Elevator Wire Rope based on YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Elevators, as essential equipment in modern urban high-rise buildings and in mining industry, rely heavily on traction steel ropes, which represent the elevator's most crucial components. During prolonged usage, issues like wire breakage and strand breakage may occur. If not promptly addressed, these issues can lead to various safety incidents resulting in injuries and property damage. Existing methods for steel rope detection, such as visual inspection and electromagnetic testing, are susceptible to external environmental influences, leading to insufficient stability in detection results. Therefore, this study proposes the use of artificial intelligence algorithms (YOLOv5s) for surface damage detection in steel ropes. Firstly, a dataset for surface damage on steel ropes has been created. Subsequently, the YOLOv5s network model has been trained using the custom dataset. The trained YOLOv5s network has been employed to extract features from images of different types of steel ropes. Experimental results shows that the steel rope surface damage detection model based on the YOLOv5s network exhibits high accuracy, excellent robustness, and fast computation speed, achieving an average detection speed of 6.7 FPS and a testing accuracy of 95.3%. This model provides an effective reference for early warning and alarm systems in elevator incidents, carrying notable practical significance.

articleTitle: Co-simulation Research of Pipeline Welding Robot Based on MATLAB and ADAMS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: A 4-axis pipeline welding robot is designed for the automatic welding operation requirements of oil and gas transportation pipelines. SolidWorks are used to simplify the structural design of the pipeline welding robot, and import the model into ADAMS for kinematics simulation to verify the reliability of the virtual prototype. ADAMS and MATLAB are used to build a co-simulation control platform, and the trajectory tracking control algorithm is used to realize the path tracking simulation of the welding process. The simulation results show that the control method can better fulfill the requirements of automatic pipeline welding, realize the precise adjustment of the welding robot’s posture, and provide a reliable basis for the development of the physical prototype.

articleTitle: Planar Trajectory Simulation for Lunar CanSats using a Wheeled Ground Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)

authors.preferredName: S M Tanvir Faysal Alam Chowdoury

abstract: This research effort attempted to employ a low cost Kobuki mobile ground robot to generate low-fidelity planar simulations of potential trajectories for CanSats operating in lunar environments. Although this mobile robot was determined to lack the capability to simulate lunar accelerations, initial tests showed that simple planar trajectories could still be successfully programmed for the motion platform. By attaching the prototype CanSats to the top of the Autonomous Ground Vehicle (AGV), the CanSat could be driven along these preprogramed trajectories. Such motion profiles provided an adequate means for initial testing of prototype optical hardware for a lunar oriented CanSat lander. Notably, significant inconsistencies were observed in the internally computed heading for the AGV. In addition to the inaccurate localization, the lack of a closed loop control system further minimized the applicability of this study. However, due to the ubiquitousness of wheeled robotic ground vehicles and the ready availability of these devices from commercial sellers at an affordable cost, there are many possible avenues for future expansion of this work. Most significantly, as systems capable of simulating microgravity environments are often very costly and require special training to operate effectively, the proposed low-cost and low-fidelity approach could provide an interim testing solution for less technologically mature space-oriented research, such as CanSats.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Elevator Door Circuit Monitoring Device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the electrical safety device which proves that the elevator door is in the locked and closed state has artificial intentional bypass, and it is tedious to find the fault point, an elevator door state monitoring system based on STM32 is designed. The data acquisition and data processing system uses STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller as the monitoring core of the elevator door status. It uses sensors to collect various status information of the elevator door. After data processing and analysis, it compares with the elevator control system data to obtain the fault information of the door status and carries out various fault alarms and displays in real time. The reliability and stability of the system can be tested by simulating the fault of the elevator door state, which can accurately judge the type and location of the elevator door failure. It not only provides accurate information for handling the elevator door fault, but also solves the accident hidden danger of deliberately bypassing the elevator door switch.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of Pipe Welding Robot Scheme Based on Robotstudio
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: In view of the current situation that all-position welding of pipeline circumferential seams relies on manual welding and automatic welding, this paper proposes four automatic robot operation schemes suitable for the welding of oil and gas pipelines in mountainous areas. According to the layout of the robot, it can be divided into: floor-mounted scheme, pipe-holding mounted scheme, ceiling mounted scheme and arc track mounted scheme. Through SolidWorks, 3D models of the four schemes are established, to import Robotstudio simulation software and perform path simulation, automatically convert the 3D model curve of the workpiece into the welding trajectory of the welding robot, and design the motion path and simulation of the welding robot. The changes of joint angle, welding torch speed, acceleration, total motor power and energy consumption during the welding operation of each scheme were analyzed. The results show that the small change of the joint angle of the arc track scheme can avoid dead spots, the small speed and acceleration of the welding torch ensure the stability and safety of the robot operation, and the small energy loss of the motor can save energy and improve work efficiency.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Pathfinding Algorithm Based on Fusion Information
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: This article proposes an improved Near End Policy Optimization (PPO) routing algorithm that integrates global and local information, and verifies its effectiveness with the routing task in self avoidance walking problems. The paper includes content such as scenario modeling, reward design, and algorithm comparison. Firstly, based on the self avoidance walking subject motion scene modeling, an algorithm input that integrates global and local information is constructed. Convolutional and fully connected networks are concatenated as the network model. Then, a three-stage reward project is designed that includes immediate rewards, stage rewards, and final rewards. Finally, it is compared with Monte Carlo method, BFS, DFS, longest path method, and PPO algorithm that uses global or local information alone. The experimental data results show that compared to traditional algorithms, our algorithm has improved the number of arrivals per round by 42.14% and the score by 40.38%.

articleTitle: Technical Research on Underwater Robot Route Planning Based on Improved PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: In the path planning problem for underwater robots, traditional algorithms have many shortcomings. This paper plans the tasks of multiple autonomous underwater vehicles using bio-mathematical methods. Two methods of global route planning based on improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm and local real-time route planning based on improved PSO algorithm are analyzed. The improved PSO algorithm, GPSO and real-time route planning algorithm using RBF (Radial Basis Function) are simulated and verified.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Robot Navigation System Based on Neural Network and FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: How to achieve autonomous navigation and attitude control for robots in uncertain environments has always been a hot research topic. This study designs an autonomous navigation closed-loop control algorithm based on artificial neural networks and implements a navigation control system for a hexapod robot with field programmable gate array (FPGA). This algorithm includes two aspects: one is the application of fuzzy control theory for fuzzy inference, and the other is autonomous learning and training through convolutional neural networks to optimize the parameters of the closed-loop control algorithm. Finally, an embedded simulation control system was composed of four modules: instruction input, fuzzy control, instruction execution, and closed-loop feedback control. The control system was applied to the autonomous navigation control of a hexapod biomimetic robot, and system testing was conducted. The test results show that the algorithm achieves flexible control of a single steering gear and coordinated control of multiple steering gears, making the robot walking based on this navigation system more stable and improving navigation performance significantly.

articleTitle: Application of STM32 Microcontroller Control System in Automation of Computer Laboratory Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: In order to realize the automatic control of computer laboratory equipment and improve the efficiency and precision of equipment control, a control system based on STM32 microcontroller is designed and developed. The system parameters the computer lab equipment by sensor data acquisition module and transmitted to the main controller in real time. After that, the main controller analyzes the collected data, and then the control algorithm module realizes the automatic control of the equipment and stores the relevant data. In addition, users can remotely control the laboratory equipment through the human-computer interaction module, which greatly provides convenience. The automated control of computer laboratory equipment has been successfully realized, and the expected effect has been achieved. As can be seen from the test results, this STM32 MCU control system is a stable and reliable control system, and the modules in it can all be expanded and upgraded, which can provide an effective solution for the research and application in related fields.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of UAV Swarm Based on Smart Contracts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Blockchain technology, characterized by its decentralized nature, traceability, automated operations, and unalterability, is well-suited to address the security requirements of UAV swarms at both theoretical and technical levels. This study delves into identifying potential security loopholes in smart contracts during their deployment, such as integer overflow, timestamp-related issues, reentrancy, transaction order dependencies, and authorization concerns. A novel detection model, integrating a hybrid neural network with an attention mechanism, is introduced to spot these vulnerabilities in smart contracts. Comparative analysis reveals that this model, referred to as ACBSC, outperforms existing popular smart contract vulnerability detection methods. It demonstrates superior accuracy and precision in identifying security flaws. The findings of this research are significant in enhancing the safety of UAV swarm operations and offer valuable insights for the unmanned sector's advancement and development.

articleTitle: Research on Trajectory Optimization of Construction Robot Based on Improved A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: In the realization of the movement of construction robots, path planning technology has become an important part of determining whether the navigation route is optimal. Aiming at the problem that the traditional A algorithm involves more direction changes and times of expansion nodes in the planning path, and has a high proportion of obstacles and low complexity. In this paper, an improved A algorithm and TEB algorithm are proposed to optimize the motion trajectory planning of construction robots, and then complete the task of construction robots docking at close range on complex walls. From the simulation and experimental results, it can be seen that compared with the traditional A* algorithm, the improved A* and TEB algorithms have higher timeliness, and can perform local path planning according to a certain frequency. The path is smooth and can generate better global path trajectory planning. In addition, high-precision robot radar can capture obstacle information in real time, accurately adjust mapping and positioning parameters, and then achieve better positioning results. At the same time, the global and local path planning algorithms can be continuously optimized to effectively compensate for the errors in the robot's motion path, thereby ensuring that the robot obtains better navigation performance.

articleTitle: Prediction of Steel Pipeline Internal Corrosion Status with Markov Chain Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Pipeline plays an important role in transporting energy across the nation. Due to its inherent property, pipe may corrode after years of service, which may bring potential risk to the safety operation of it. This paper proposed a model to predict the corrosion status of pipeline with Markov chain theory. The basic principle of Markov chain theory was introduced and definition of transition probability matrix was established. A case study of predicting steel pipeline corrosion status was conducted. This case includes three corrosion data of a certain pipe corrosion flaw at different inspection periods and criteria for evaluating corrosion status was defined based on ASME B31G. Results show that the pipeline will fail after 33 years of service, though this result may vary according to the selection of initial status, it could somehow indicate the general growth trend of the flaw. Grey theory was also briefly introduced herein to tackle with discontinuous time sequence data. Conclusions drawn from the study could serve as references for optimizing pipeline inspection schedule.

articleTitle: An Improved Semi-Dense Iterative Closest Point Registration Algorithm Fusing Intrinsic Shape Signatures and Curvature Feature
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Point clouds registration is a key step in three- dimension data processing and the Iterative Closest Point algorithm has been widely for this task. An improved semi-dense Iterative Closest Point registration algorithm fusing Intrinsic Shape Signatures and curvature feature is proposed in this paper to solve the problem of large-scale and small-overlap point clouds registration. Firstly, the semi-dense point cloud is generated by a voxel grid filter and the feature points of Intrinsic Shape Signatures are extracted from the semi-dense point cloud for coarse registration. Then in coarse registration step, the super 4-Points Congruent Sets algorithm is used to get better registration results, even on partial overlapping point clouds. Finally, fine registration is completed by using an improved Iterative Closest Point algorithm based on curvature feature and K-D tree. Experiments on indoor and outdoor 3D point cloud data show that the proposed algorithm in this paper is more accurate, efficient and robust compared with the traditional ICP algorithm, especially for large-scale and small-overlap point clouds.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Feature Point Detection and Target Reconstruction Suitable For Agricultural Applications in Alpine Forest Terrain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: The application of intelligent robots in alpine forest terrain agriculture holds substantial significance, addressing challenges posed by complex landscapes and labor scarcity in traditional farming methods. These robots serve as viable substitutes for human labor, offering continuous support and resolving workforce shortages. By employing precise positioning and operational capabilities, intelligent robots enhance land utilization efficiency and maximize crop yield within limited arable land. This paper explores the background and importance of employing intelligent robots in alpine forest terrain agriculture. It also introduces characteristic detection methods and object reconstruction algorithms suitable for robots in such terrain. The findings underscore the considerable potential of employing intelligent robots in alpine forest terrain agriculture, fostering agricultural modernization and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Intelligent Assisted Navigation for Ships Using Edge Computing and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of high real-time and stability in the process of ship navigation, this paper applies an intelligent auxiliary means based on edge computing and convolutional neural network (CNN). The edge computing platform is deployed on the ship, and sensors and cameras are used to collect surrounding data. The convolutional neural network models are trained to accurately recognize and classify different types of obstacles, and real-time environmental perception and analysis are performed. Intelligent driving assistance decisions such as automatic obstacle avoidance, path planning, and speed control are provided based on the analysis results. The research results indicate that the average recovery time of the system is between 5.8 minutes and 29.5 minutes, with an accuracy of 0.97 in obstacle recognition tasks. The method can achieve intelligent assistance for ship navigation with high real-time performance and stability.

articleTitle: Algorithm Design for Kicking by Bipedal Robots Based on Improved CMA-ES
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: In response to the issue of slow attack speed and low success rate of football robots' kicking in dynamic environments during RoboCup competitions, an algorithm for bipedal robot kicking was devised using an enhanced Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) algorithm. To tackle the problem of CMA-ES getting trapped in local optima, a combined approach of Tent chaotic mapping and Lévy flight random numbers was introduced to widen the search range and increase the population size, thus enhancing the algorithm's ability for global exploration. The refined CMA-ES algorithm was employed to optimize kicking parameters, with parameter feasibility assessed using inverse kinematics. Moreover, a kicking cost function was utilized to determine optimal kicking point coordinates, and trajectory optimization was performed using Bézier curve interpolation. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the method were validated through simulation experiments using SimRobot and physical experiments with NAO robots.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Material Identification Method Combining Gray Feature and Color Feature
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Material sorting is a very important link in the industrial production process, and its efficiency directly affects the efficiency of the entire industrial production process. In order to improve the efficiency of material sorting and meet the needs of material image recognition, a new material identification method is proposed in this paper, which uses the gray and color features of material images to identify materials. Compared with the traditional material identification method, this method has the characteristics of lightweight and high efficiency. The experimental results show that the method can classify material images with a high speed and the overall accuracy reaches 95%. The recognition of a single picture only takes 0.009 seconds, which can reduce the cost and improve the production efficiency in the actual industrial production scene, and has certain practical value.

articleTitle: Threat Assessment Method for Cluster Targets Based on GWO-IFE
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Electromagnetic killing is characterized by high efficiency and low cost when dealing with the threat of low, slow and small cluster targets. Firstly, For the characteristics of electromagnetic energy to target can be calculated and the damage effect can be assessed, this paper proposed power to target, cost of attack and other indicators to calculate the target threat degree. Secondly, this paper proposed an assessment method based on GWO-IEF (Grey Wolf Optimizer-Intuitionistic Fuzzy Entropy) to solve the problem of low efficiency of threat degree calculation. Finally, Simulation proves that this method has high computational efficiency and solution accuracy, and compared with the traditional target threat assessment method based on dynFWA-IEF (Dynamic Search Fireworks Algorithm-Intuitionistic Fuzzy Entropy), the computational speed is improved by nearly 54.63%, and the generated results are consistent with the expected electromagnetic weapon attack capability.

articleTitle: Research on Fine-Grained Image Recognition Based on Foreground Extraction and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Fine-grained image recognition has entered researchers' field of vision due to its finer recognition results, and it also provides a deeper recognition approach for bird identification. Fine-grained image recognition is characterized by small inter-class differences and large intra-class differences, as traditional recognition methods have poor real-time performance and inaccurate classification. Additionally, the presence of noisy backgrounds in images can also affect recognition results. Therefore, this paper proposes a method for fine-grained image recognition based on foreground extraction and convolutional neural networks. Semantic segmentation technology is used to extract the foreground from the original image, then features are extracted from the foreground with higher subject-specific characteristics. A local attention module is utilized to select features, retaining important ones. Compared to the baseline model on the public dataset CUB-200-2011, this model achieves an accuracy improvement of over 2%.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Aerial Image Dehazing Algorithm Based on CycleGAN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Effective perception of the environment is a prerequisite for autonomous detection by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), and accurate acquisition of visual images is the most crucial aspect. Considering that the visibility of UAV visual images is greatly affected by natural factors such as fog, and current dehazing algorithms are not very effective, this paper proposes a dehazing method for UAV images based on a cyclic generative adversarial network with an atrous spatial pyramid pooling and attention module. The unpaired image unsupervised dehazing task is performed using the constrained transfer learning ability of the CycleGAN. Considering the severe loss of edge details in actual foggy images and the complex distribution of fog, it is necessary to combine real visual features for dehazing. This paper replaces the ordinary convolution with the ASPP module and incorporates the Convolutional Block Attention Module into the network to non-uniformly process different features and areas in foggy images. Experimental results show that this method achieves better results on the foggy image dataset.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Six-axis Manipulator Based on Solidworks and ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: A 6-DOF joint welding robot with a vertical axis series mechanism is designed and studied. SolidWorks is used to conduct three-dimensional structural modeling and analysis of the robot to make the subsequent processing, production, debugging, and assembly of the equipment have practical feasibility and usability. After the modeling and analysis are completed, the static and dynamic mechanical characteristics of the robot are analyzed according to the structural characteristics of the robot. Firstly, the torque of the robot's joint is calculated, and the analysis of the SolidWorks plug-in Motion verifies the calculation results. After the verification is completed, the model is imported into ANSYS Workbench. Transient dynamics analysis is carried out on the robot's waist, lower arm, upper arm, wrist, and hand, and simulation mechanical analysis and structural analysis are carried out on the whole robot. The stress and strain data results and change rules on each robot component are obtained through the research and analysis method combined with SolidWorks and ANSYS Workbench to ensure its structure has sufficient mechanical strength and toughness to meet the long-term motion state during actual use.

articleTitle: Application Research of High-Precision Ultrasonic Technology in Position Sensing for Pneumatic Actuators
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: In response to the problems of poor environmental adaptability, real-time performance, and insufficient response speed in traditional research, this paper improved the environmental adaptability, real-time performance, and response speed of the system by optimizing sensor selection and layout, signal processing and filtering, hardware and algorithm optimization. In terms of sensor selection and arrangement, the MaxBotix MB7360 sensor was selected and a multi-sensor arrangement (surround and overlap) was adopted to improve measurement reliability and stability. The frequency domain analysis and least squares fitting curve of Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) are used for signal processing and filtering optimization. Then, the digital low-pass filter processed the signal collected by the sensor to eliminate high-frequency noise and interference, while retaining effective signal components. In order to optimize hardware and algorithms, the high-performance embedded processor ARM Cortex-M series was adopted. This series of embedded processors was combined with fast ADC (analog-to-digital converter) modules to achieve rapid acquisition and processing of sensor signals. Finally, through improved PID control algorithm and adaptive sliding mode control strategy, real-time and precise control of pneumatic actuator position was achieved. The experimental results showed that using optimization methods achieved significant improvements in accuracy, stability, and response speed compared to traditional methods. The optimized system has significantly improved environmental adaptability, real-time performance, and response speed, providing reliable technical support for precise control of pneumatic actuators, which is of great significance for the development of industrial automation control systems.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Liquid Level Control Algorithm for Oil Electric Drive Sand Mixing Truck
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: The automatic control system of the sand mixing truck is one of the core equipment in oil fracturing operations. The liquid level control of the sand mixing tank is a key link in the control system of the sand mixing truck. Its control effect not only affects the efficiency of fracturing operations, but also affects the safety of equipment and operators. This article takes the liquid level control system of a 130 barrel electric drive sand mixing truck as the research platform, establishes the transfer function of the water tank liquid level, and proposes a new control strategy by combining traditional PID control with fuzzy control algorithm. The simulation and experimental results show that compared with traditional PID control strategies, this method can solve the problems of multiple time delays and nonlinearity in liquid level control systems, and has advantages such as fast response, small overshoot, and small steady-state deviation. It improves the efficiency and stability of sand mixing operations.

articleTitle: Local Layer Power Control for DC Microgrid VRB Energy Storage System Based on Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Based on the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG), this paper proposes a local power control strategy for the Vanadium Redox Battery (VRB) energy storage system in DC microgrids. This strategy effectively addresses issues such as anti-interference and low precision in the local control layer of the DC microgrid VRB energy storage system during actual operation. This study employs a literature review and case analysis approach, exploring both theoretical and practical perspectives. In the local control layer of the VRB energy storage system, it is necessary to quickly track the power demand instructions issued by the power distribution layer. At the same time, influenced by national standards, it is essential to improve the controller's precision and response speed while ensuring the system meets the required response time and power control accuracy. The research findings indicate that by incorporating the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient as an auxiliary controller, and utilizing the DDPG algorithm for online training and learning, the response speed and anti-interference ability of the main controller can be enhanced. Furthermore, by combining the main and auxiliary controllers to form a joint control system, the controller can quickly and accurately track power demand instructions.

Author Keywords: Vanadium Redox Battery Energy Storage System

articleTitle: TDIS: Medical Image Recognition Based on Target Detection and Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: The recognition of medical images has the characteristics of large image changes and insignificant grayscale changes, which requires medical personnel to repeatedly observe and compare. In view of the above characteristics, TDIS, a system solution suitable for medical image processing is proposed. First, the improved YOLOv8 convolutional neural network algorithm is used to perform target detection on the data set to detect a larger range of lesions, and then the improved UNet algorithm is used to segment the range. This paper used the ISIC2017 data set to conduct experiments, and the results show that the systematic solution TDIS proposed in this article can make up for the shortcomings of the existing medical image detection system, improve the accuracy of detection, and promote the development of automation and intelligence in clinical medicine.

articleTitle: Mine Dust Concentration Prediction Based on PSO Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: This paper aims to use the computer assisted Neural Network algorithm to accurately predict the dust concentration in coal mines and effectively prevent and control the dust hazards. To this end, this paper adopts a Particle Swarm Optimization Neural Network prediction model (PSO-NN model) optimized by genetic algorithm to predict the time series dust concentration of a working face in a coal mine. The prediction accuracy assessment of the model is tested by evaluating the relative error and the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of the prediction results. Also, the prediction results of the PSO-NN model with those of the PSO neural network prediction model and the convolutional neural network prediction model (CNN model) is compared and verified, and evaluate the prediction performance of the three models using the root mean square error (RMSE). The results show that the PSO-NN model achieves a high-precision prediction, with the relative error range of 5.27% to 0.16%, and the MAPE of the prediction samples meeting the requirements. The PSO-NN model also outperforms the CNN and PSO models, with the lowest RMSE value of 0.9335. This indicates that the PSO-NN model can accurately predict the dust concentration in coal mines under the conditions of only one time influencing factor and small sample size.

articleTitle: Design of Drug Detection System Based on Internet of Things Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: With the continuous development and innovation of the drug industry, the requirements for drug quality are also increasing. The quality problems of drugs can lead to serious health risks and economic losses, so it is important to monitor and control drug quality. Traditional drug quality testing methods have some limitations, such as manual sampling and laboratory testing, which are time-consuming and cannot be monitored in real time. In response to the problem that traditional drug testing systems cannot effectively monitor the quality of drugs in real-time, a drug testing system based on Internet of Things (IoT) sensors was designed based on in-depth analysis of IoT technology and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology. The system used IoT sensors to collect drug quality information, and transmitted the data to the monitoring center for analysis and processing through wireless communication networks, achieving real-time monitoring of drug quality. After testing, the reliability of the system was as high as 94.9%, which could stably collect, transmit, and analyze drug quality information, thereby ensuring the quality and safety of drugs.

articleTitle: Flow-Graph Based Optimization of Containerized Resource Scheduling: An Efficient Scheduling Algorithm for Kubernetes Clusters
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: With the widespread adoption of containerization technology and the evolution of cloud computing, efficient scheduling of containerized applications in cluster environments has become an increasingly important area of research. Kubernetes, as a mainstream container orchestration tool, faces several challenges with its default queue-based and greedy scheduling algorithm, especially in large-scale deployments, such as high latency and low scheduling robustness. This paper introduces a flow-graph-based optimization method for containerized resource scheduling, modeling the scheduling problem as a Minimum Cost Maximum Flow problem to achieve global optimization. Comparative experiments with traditional queue-based and random scheduling algorithms demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method in terms of balanced resource utilization, robustness of scheduling outcomes, and reduced algorithmic latency. This study provides a more efficient resource scheduling strategy for container orchestration tools like Kubernetes and offers a new perspective on resource management in large-scale containerized application environments.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Optical Wireless Localization System Towards Dataset Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach for the development of system design and architecture for the data generation methods tailored for indoor localization within Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) systems. We explore key aspects of the Optical Wireless Localization (OWL) dataset generation method, namely hardware design and simulation-based high-precision localization. While physical architecture is well-established, dataset generation and hardware design methods require innovation. In this study, we propose an enhanced hardware design technology that combines collected indoor localization dataset generation with Deep neural network testing. This approach allows not only for the dataset generation of optical wireless localization in location-based OWC systems but also the high precision of positioning accuracy. The paper details the process, benefits, and outcomes of this innovative methodology.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Machine Vision-based Workpiece Defect Sorting Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of industrial automation level, machine vision technology has been widely applied in the field of workpiece defect detection and sorting. In response to this demand, this paper proposes and designs a machine vision-based workpiece defect sorting system. This system integrates advanced technologies such as camera calibration, image preprocessing, and deep learning, which can efficiently and accurately identify workpiece defects and achieve automatic sorting. To verify the performance of the system, an experimental platform close to actual industrial scenarios was built, and extensive tests were conducted on workpieces of different types and batches. The experimental results show that the system has good robustness and reliability in complex environments, with a defect detection rate of over 98% and a sorting efficiency more than three times that of manual methods. Compared with traditional manual inspection methods, the machine vision sorting system significantly improves production efficiency and product quality, providing a feasible technical solution for the intelligent development of industries such as discrete manufacturing, with broad application prospects. In the future, machine vision technology is expected to play an important role in more industrial scenarios, promoting intelligent and high-quality development in manufacturing.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Robotic Dog’s Machine Learning-Based Detection for Pedestrians and Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the deployment of an innovative autonomous inspection system to facilitate data collection, specifically focusing on pedestrian and vehicle counts within transportation infrastructure. Utilizing bio-inspired robots, such as a robot dog, we explore new horizons in data gathering that supersede conventional methods. The robot dog, with its ability to navigate multiple terrains, acts as the primary data collection agent, ensuring accuracy and comprehensiveness. These technologies together pave the way for real-time monitoring of pedestrian and vehicle flow, offering a holistic view of transportation usage and patterns. By integrating this data with Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), the paper highlights the potential for creating smarter and more efficient transportation networks. This contemporary approach to data collection aligns with the rigorous standards and guidelines set forth by entities like AASHTO, emphasizing the role of automated systems in shaping the future of transportation management and infrastructure monitoring.

articleTitle: Application of Association Rule Algorithm in Chronic Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Chronic diseases, particularly chronic kidney diseases, have currently jeopardized people’s healthy life, with tens of thousands suffering from the disease each year. To improve the situation and, accordingly, to alleviate the caused harm, predictive research has attracted significant attention to itself. In line with this, among the numerous prediction research algorithms, Apriori is one of the most used ones. However, the algorithm suffers from a number of problems, including a reduction in its execution efficiency as well as the generation of more frequent item sets when the database is scanned for several times. As a consequence, more meaningless association rules are generated in predicting the disease. Therefore, for optimizing the Apriori association rules, the present study aims at proposing an algorithm based on pointer array and difference set theory. The results showed that the use of pointer array led to the quick reduction of memory occupation and the used time for intersection, which in turn, improved the execution efficiency of the algorithm. Moreover, experiments were carried out to verify different support thresholds and transaction records, the obtained results of which demonstrated a great improvement in memory space occupancy and execution time. Finally, the algorithm was applied to predict the chronic diseases, the results of which realized the probability prediction to a certain extent, provided a reference for specialists to diagnose the diseases, and was significant for the promotion of automated medical treatment.

articleTitle: Text Representation Based on WT-GloVe Word Vector Weighting Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: The text representation issue in text classification is thoroughly examined in this paper, with a focus on handling massive volumes of text data. The paper suggests the word vector weighting model based on WT-GloVe in response to the issues with excessive sparsity and subpar classification performance that classic neural network text representation models frequently confront. To find important information in the text, the model first extracts features from the text using a feature weighting approach based on word spacing and interclass contribution. This work then presents a filtering technique that tries to enhance the training quality and relevance of word vectors in order to address the issue of irrelevant words that may be introduced by the GloVe model in word vector training. This work effectively builds a weighted word vector model that can precisely capture the value of feature words and rich semantic information by combining the feature weighting technique with irrelevant word screening. According to experimental results, the model performs better in numerous text classification assignments when compared to existing models, demonstrating its efficacy in enhancing text representation performance. The paper enriches the field of text representation by offering a fresh approach and aiding in the advancement of Natural Language Processing technology.

articleTitle: Research on Tea Disease Model Based on Improved ResNet34 and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of tea leaf disease recognition with complex background and low accuracy in real environment, this study improved ResNet34 first-layer convolution layer model and combined with different migration methods to build tea disease recognition model. To enhance the model's generalization ability, transfer learning is integrated into the ResNet34 model, and the pre-trained parameter weights are transferred to the original model for training, so as to improve the training speed. Then, by comparing the performance of all four models, namely migration, feature extraction, fine-tuning, and new training, The experimental results show that the test accuracy of the fine-tuned ResNet34 model reaches 94.67%, which is 0.41% higher than that of the whole migration model and 6.56% higher than that of the original ResNet34 model. In addition, the modified fine-tuning model reduces the iteration time of each round by 37.21% compared with the original ResNet34 model. The research shows that the improved model has strong robustness to self-built data sets such as sample imbalance and background heterogeneity. The fine-tuning model can reduce the number of parameters and the reduction of calculation, accelerate the convergence rate of the model, and facilitate the deployment of the model to the mobile terminal equipment of intelligent agriculture in the future, providing useful guidance for the intelligent prevention and control of tea diseases and ensuring the food safety of tea.

articleTitle: A Metamorphic Robot for Post-disaster
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of complex terrain exploration in post-disaster rescue work, enhance the application scope of post-disaster rescue robots, expand the application scenarios of robots in post-disaster rescue, and reduce the risk of post-disaster rescue, a metamorphic robot for post-disaster rescue is developed in this project. This paper describes the overall structure of the robot design, motion device design, metamorphic structure design, and introduces the hardware and software aspects of the robot control system in detail. The robot uses a multi-legged metamorphic structure to deal with different complex terrains, and adds image recognition, obstacle avoidance navigation technology and radar ranging technology to deal with complex situations in post-disaster rescue. The performance of the robot was evaluated through simulations and field tests in a variety of behind-the-scenes scenarios, including traversing debris piles, crawling through narrow gaps, and climbing obstacles. The results show that the work stability is strong, and it can be applied to most of the disaster relief work scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Foreign Object Detection of Transmission Line Based on Improved YoloV5
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: As the transmission power network is expanding, The traditional manual fault detection approach reveals a relatively low level of efficiency and is considerably influenced by human factors. In this article, an outstanding and innovative foreign object detection approach for transmission lines based on the enhanced YOLOv5 is presented. The lightweight network unit C2F is utilized to substitute the C3 module for compressing the size of the network model. Via the introduction of the Biformer module, with the aim of attaining a substantial improvement in the feature extraction capacity of the model. Employ the Focal loss function to substitute the cross-entropy loss function adopted in the original model, thereby reducing the impact of the sample imbalance problem on the model training and simultaneously enhancing the convergence rate of the model. The improved model parameters are reduced by 25.47 %, The number of floating-point operations has decreased by 30.16%, the number of frames transmitted per second has been enhanced by 17.6%. The mAP value has got a boost of 2.81%.

articleTitle: FPDTN: Fast Plant Digital Twin Model for IoT Automated Greenhouse Based on NeRF
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: This study aims to develop an innovative and cost-effective digital twin technology called Fast Plant Digital Twin (FPDTN), leveraging Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) for efficient 3D modeling of plant morphology in IoT-enabled greenhouses. FPDTN addresses scalability and financial constraints inherent in traditional digital twins, offering a novel solution. Through the creation of a unique dataset and methodology, FPDTN demonstrates superior accuracy in simulating plant morphology compared to existing models. The findings highlight FPDTN's significant advancements in digital twin technology tailored for botanical applications, emphasizing the critical necessity for scalable, cost-effective solutions adaptable across diverse domains. This paper concludes by emphasizing FPDTN's substantial contributions to the field and advocating ongoing exploration and innovation in digital twin technologies.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Spatial Information Networks: A Security Knowledge Graph-based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Anomaly detection stands as a critical element in securing space information networks (SINs). This paper delves into the realm of anomaly detection within dynamic networks, shedding light on established methodologies. The focus lies on scrutinizing various anomaly detection strategies in space information networks, conducting a comprehensive assessment of their practical applications, advantages, and drawbacks. Moreover, it introduces a novel anomaly detection approach driven by deep learning principles. This innovative method merges graph convolution techniques with a network security-oriented knowledge graph, presenting a cutting-edge solution. As a final contribution, the paper extends its purview to the future landscape of anomaly detection within space information networks, offering valuable insights into potential advancements and forthcoming trends in this domain. This holistic investigation seeks to enhance the understanding of anomaly detection paradigms within the unique context of space information networks, aiming to fortify their security measures and operational resilience.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Automatic Parking System for Vehicle Emergency Braking and Mistakenly Stepping on the Accelerator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: This study aims to design an intelligent parking system for emergency braking and preventing accidental stepping on the accelerator in automobiles. The system includes a sensor circuit, a data processing circuit, and an electronically driven anti-skid system connected to the vehicle. The sensor circuit detects the speed at which the driver presses the gas pedal, capturing signals that are then output to the data processing circuit. The data processing circuit processes the collected signals and calculates the duration of the driver's gas pedal press. If the duration of the gas pedal press is less than or equal to a predefined threshold, it is determined to be an erroneous operation. A braking signal is then sent to the vehicle's electronically driven anti-skid system, controlling it to perform an emergency braking operation, which safely stops the vehicle and prevents traffic accidents caused by mistaking the gas pedal for the brake.

articleTitle: Ground Solar Irradiation Prediction Based on Feature Analysis of Ground-based Cloud Images Sequences by 3D CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Predicting target motion based on 3D CNN is currently a popular research direction. Using 3D CNN to predict cloud object motion in ground-based cloud maps for surface radiation prediction has become a feasible solution. Due to the insufficient ability to analyze the dynamic features of cloud image sequences in existing researches, the prediction accuracy significantly decreased under complicated climate conditions. This article proposed a method of using 3D CNN to simultaneously extract static features and dynamic features of cloud image sequences, establish the correlation between cloud image sequence features and the attenuation of surface solar radiation by clouds, and achieve high-precision surface solar prediction. The evaluation results of experiments shows that, in complicated climate conditions, the RMSE of 5 minutes ahead prediction was raised 8% by the proposed method compared with the existing works. The proposed method has high promotion value.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning of Mobile Robot Based on A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Mobile robots are widely used in industrial, medical, agricultural and other scenarios. The core technology is path planning. The existing methods have limited ability to deal with complex environment, low search efficiency, unsmooth path, easy to trap local optimum, and lack of real-time performance. Intelligent algorithm is a better method to solve this problem. Because the A * algorithm has strong search ability, clear algorithm thinking, and can be constrained to the global optimal path, it has the advantages of high efficiency, stability and optimality. Therefore, a motion trajectory planning method based on A * algorithm is proposed for mobile robots. Firstly, this paper analyzes several commonly used mobile robot path planning algorithms, and selects the A * algorithm as the object of this study. Secondly, the working principle, advantages and disadvantages of the A * algorithm are introduced in detail, as well as the design modules of the A * algorithm. Then, the problem of motion trajectory planning for mobile robots is analyzed and a solution is proposed. Aiming at the problems of low planning efficiency, turning path, sharp and unsmooth path, the efficiency and stability of A * algorithm are optimized by adding heuristic algorithm, corner optimization and path smoothing. Finally, the working environment of the mobile robot is established by using the grid method, and the path planning simulation experiment is carried out on the MATLAB platform. The experimental results show that the method of path planning using A * algorithm is effective and has a wide application prospect.

articleTitle: An Image Stitching Technique Based on Image Moments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: With the evolution of technology and the advancement of computer science, image moments have gained increasingly widespread application in the field of image analysis. Geometric moment computation stands as a pivotal topic in the domain of image processing. Nevertheless, the computational complexity associated with moment calculations is relatively high, to a certain extent constraining its practical applicability. This paper delves into the investigation of various aspects, including the representation of high-order moments, the selection of image moment orders, parallel computation of image moments, and image stitching based on image moments. It deduces high-order moment functions, utilizing these higher-order moments for the extraction of image features, thereby enhancing the accuracy and stability of image feature representation. Based on actual images, the algorithm selects the expression of moment function orders, balancing the choice of image moment orders by weighing preset target quantities and sampling parameters. This provides a more targeted image moment calculation scheme for practical applications. The moment calculation algorithm is optimized by transforming multiplication operations into addition operations, simplifying the complexity of the original serial calculations. Through parallel computation, the computational workload is reduced, thus enhancing the performance of image moments in practical applications. Employing machine learning methods and deep learning techniques in conjunction with image moments facilitates image recognition and classification, thereby improving recognition efficiency.

articleTitle: Adaptive Neural Dynamic Surface Control for a Prosthetic Thigh Simulation Robot of Gait Simulation and Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Robotics (ICICR)
abstract: Artificial intelligence and robots have had a profound impact on the healthcare sector. In this paper, an adaptive neural control scheme of a prosthetic thigh simulation robot (PTSR) of gait simulation and evaluation system (GSE) is presented for hip disarticulation prostheses (HDPs) testing. To achieve the L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance of system tracking error, a simple error modification term in traditional backstepping (BS) design procedure via adaptive neural networks (NNs) approach is employed. Then by using the initialization technique (IT) and error modification term, the initial values of the compact sets used in adaptive NNs control scheme can be reduced by adjusting design parameters, which means that the stability and the tracking performance of the closed loop system can be improved greatly. Furthermore, this approach addresses and resolves the issues of disturbance caused by the tested HDPs and the constraints on PTSR in the stability analysis of previous studies. Additionally, the design procedure is simplified and the computational burden is reduced through the utilization of dynamic surface control technique (DSC) and minimal learning algorithm (MLP). The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
